subject: Finalizing Q3 investor packet — timeline & signoffs
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: Board Secretary <boardsec@peakcap.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft investor packet & signoff timeline

Team —

Attached is a near-final draft of the Q3 investor packet (v3). Main asks: please review the Executive Summary and the two slides in the "Business Health" section for accuracy and sign off by Monday EOD PT.

Key timeline:
- Today (Fri 8/7): internal reviews / send redlines
- Mon 8/10 morning: I will consolidate and circulate v4 for a quick leadership pass
- Mon 8/10 3pm PT: send final to Peak Capital boardsec (boardsec@peakcap.com) for distribution to the board

Open items I want resolved in this pass:
1) Revenue vs ARR phrasing on slide 6 — make consistent with pitch numbers (Laura)
2) One-line note clarifying Dedicated capacity growth vs hosted revenue (Markus)
3) Updated unit economics and cost per token metric in appendix (Monica)
4) Any material ask of the board (credits, runway visibility) — call out explicitly (Tessa)

I've also left speaker notes for the CEO talking points. Link to the deck: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Q3_investor_deck_v3

Attachments: 2026_Q3_investor_packet_v3.pptx, metrics_appendix_v3.xlsx

Thanks — please flag anything that must wait for legal/finance review so we can adjust the send cadence.

Vivek Kulkarni
Co-founder, Head of Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 11:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft investor packet & signoff timeline

Vivek — quick pass done. A few notes inline in the deck (comments on slide 6 and executive summary):
- Slide 6: changed "Q/Q" to "vs prior quarter" phrasing and added a clarifying footnote about seasonal customer onboarding cycles.
- Exec summary: tightened revenue language and added the net new logos callout.

No blockers from my side for Monday signoff, assuming Markus and Monica confirm the numbers.

On the timing — are we still planning to include the brief ask for a short call with top investors after distribution? If so, we should include proposed dates in the cover email.

Laura Bennett
VP, Finance
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 8 Aug 2026 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft investor packet & signoff timeline

Thanks — I pushed one paragraph that clarifies Dedicated capacity growth (slide 9) and a short chart comparing hosted vs dedicated ARR mix. Also updated the bullet about gross margins to reflect the new quantization-related cost-savings we started measuring in June.

Two asks for clarity:
1) Monica — can you confirm the unit economics numbers in the appendix? The per-token cost delta should reflect our June batch-caching changes.
2) Vivek — do we want to include a short note about product roadmap risks (one slide) or keep the deck purely growth-focused? My vote: one slide with mitigations.

—Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Product
Redwood Inference
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com, markus_klein@markus_klein@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 8 Aug 2026 14:45:30 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft investor packet & signoff timeline

Vivek — attaching my redlines (PDF) and a short list here. I flagged three items that may need legal language or risk balancing:
- Slide 4 (metrics): the pipeline lifetime value projection needs a qualifier about conservative booking assumptions — added bracketed text.
- Slide 11 (customer logos): two logos need permissions for use — Monica, please confirm if we have signed logo usage clauses.
- Slide 13 (ask): the phrasing around credits for one large customer could be read as a negotiated concession; suggested we reframe as a short-term promotional credit and include a sunset date.

Attachment: redlines_tessa_comments.pdf

If legal needs to do a pass, we should still be able to hit Monday morning internal signoff; pushing to Monday afternoon to send to the board is my fallback.

Tessa Morgan
Head of Growth & GTM
Redwood Inference
From: Board Secretary <boardsec@peakcap.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Anne Wilson <anne.wilson@peakcap.com>
Date: Sun, 9 Aug 2026 07:10:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Draft investor packet & signoff timeline

Vivek — thanks for the heads up and the planned timeline. We can accept the deck Monday afternoon; would you be able to confirm the final file by 3pm PT on 8/10 so we can distribute to the board by evening? Also, please include a one-paragraph cover note for board members outlining any asks and proposed next steps.

Best,
Board Secretary
Peak Capital
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: Board Secretary <boardsec@peakcap.com>
Date: Sun, 9 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft investor packet & signoff timeline

Team — final pass complete. Actions taken:
- Consolidated Laura and Markus edits into v4 and refreshed the appendix numbers (metrics_appendix_v3.xlsx).
- Incorporated Tessa's suggested phrasing for the credits ask (now labeled "Promotional credit — limited term") and added the sunset date in the speaker notes.
- Legal reviewed the pipeline qualifier and OK'd the language for slide 4.

Attached: 2026_Q3_investor_packet_v3.pptx (final v4), metrics_appendix_v3.xlsx, redlines_tessa_comments.pdf

I approve sending to Peak Capital at 3pm PT today. Proposed cover note (for boardsec distribution):

"Dear board — please find our Q3 investor packet attached. Highlights include 38% growth in Dedicated ARR, improved unit economics from caching/quantization changes, and a short ask for a promotional credit pilot with a limited sunset. We propose a 30-minute update call the week of Aug 17 to review Q3 traction and product roadmap mitigations. Please let us know your availability."

If there are no objections by 2:30pm PT, I will send the final to boardsec and share the HubSpot deal link.

Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround — excellent cross-functional work.

Vivek Kulkarni
Co-founder, Head of Ops
Redwood Inference
